g.text: Actual normalized floor boundaries and openings / separate floors share the same origin and scale
Dark blue: complete opaque building mass.
Colored faces: walkable floor at the labeled
Z. Gray outlined holes: open stair wells,
not floor. Green-gray ravine and tan rock:
Cream breaks D01–D23 are movement openings,
each with declared width and headroom.
Purple W02/W03 are observation only. Hatched
flights and dashed road arrows are explicit
and +4. Press stair house: +4 and +8. School
lower arcade / occupied upper room: +4 and
+8, with 3.7 m clear below the upper slab.
Thick dark edges are full-height enclosure
or 2.4 m observation screens. Thin tan edges
are 1.1 m guards. Stair-end joins are open;
side guards follow the actual grade. Exact
polygons, holes and edge IDs: layout.json.
L02 developed prediction after R02 spatial-
interest return. Original body retained. No
timing or balance acceptance. R02 and
rejected L01 remain as revision evidence.
Meters, right-handed Z-up, north +Y. Radius .30 / standing 1.80 / crouch 1.10 / step .30 / slope 42 degrees. The three cross-town commitments remain: shore, middle market crossing
